evals.name: tags-plan
evals.prompt: The plan in docs/plans/2026-10-14-bookmark-tags.md is approved. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Five commits, one per task, each leaving npm test green; every checkbox ticked; the plan's names and signatures in the code; the CLI tags and filters end to end; a summary with deviations and how it works.
expectations: Five new commits, one per task
Every new commit leaves npm test passing
All five task checkboxes are ticked
src/tags.ts exports normalizeTag and InvalidTagError
BookmarkStore has tag(id: number, tag: string) and listByTag(tag: string)
A test file covers normalizeTag
The CLI tags a bookmark and lists it by tag end to end
A file written before tags existed still loads
The working tree is clean
evals.tests: A plan that fits the code; task-by-task commits, green steps, plan fidelity and an end-to-end result.

evals.name: csv-store
evals.prompt: The plan in docs/plans/2026-10-14-bookmark-tags.md is approved. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Builds task 1 (normalizeTag), then sees at task 2 that the store is a CSV file whose columns are a public format the plan assumed was JSON, marks it blocked and asks how tags should be stored, with a recommendation. Nothing past task 1 is built.
expectations: Task 1 is ticked and src/tags.ts is committed
Tasks 2 to 5 are not ticked
The stored CSV format is unchanged
src/cli.ts is unchanged
Response asks how tags should be stored in the CSV file
npm test passes
evals.tests: A plan that is wrong about stored data; stopping at an expensive-to-reverse deviation instead of building past it.

evals.name: plan-needs-fix
evals.prompt: The plan in docs/plans/2026-10-14-bookmark-tags.md is approved. Implement it.
evals.expected_output: Builds all five tasks, but declares InvalidTagError's raw input as a class field instead of the plan's parameter property (AGENTS.md: Node cannot strip them), updates the plan's signature to match and names the deviation in the summary.
expectations: All five task checkboxes are ticked
npm test passes
The code has no parameter property in src/tags.ts
The plan no longer declares a parameter property for InvalidTagError
Response names the deviation from the plan
evals.tests: A cheap deviation the code forces; whether the plan is kept true to the code and the deviation reported.
